reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getMonthWideCategories selection with a parameter instead of adding a new query; handler types flow via typeof.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in one place; a shared MonthWideActionArgs type replaces six inline arg types.

placement.why: The rule change lives in the shared selection helper in budget/actions.ts where the other exclusions already are.

scope.why: Only the selection helper, the six month-wide signatures and one test change.

maintainability.why: Small, explicit boolean parameter on the single selection function; easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep calling getMonthWideCategories.
